doc.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Jazz is low sick
summary: He feels jazz lacks clubs and is low sick.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Why? Why do you feel that way?
Why do I feel that way? Because I look around me. I don’t see any jazz. I don’t see any clubs. I don’t see any — don’t you feel that way?
Well I think there’s a certain smaller group of people that are keeping it alive.
